author: Ari Koslow
title: Josh Simpson optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Mariners optioned Josh Simpson to Triple-A Tacoma.
impact: Simpson will return to Triple-A with Cole Wilcox recalled as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cole Wilcox recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Mariners recalled Cole Wilcox from Triple-A Tacoma.
impact: Wilcox will add a fresh arm in the bullpen for Seattle.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luke Raley (elbow) out of lineup Tuesday
desc: Luke Raley remains out of the Mariners lineup on Tuesday against the Angels.
impact: Raley remains day-to-day and hopeful to avoid a stint on the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dominic Canzone not in lineup Tuesday
desc: Dominic Canzone is not in the Mariners lineup on Tuesday against the Angels.
impact: Canzone is continuing to battle through a hamstring injury. Randy Arozarena is serving as the designated hitter on Tuesday.

author: Chase Davis
title: Max Muncy stays hot with another long ball in win
desc: Max Muncy went 2-for-5 in a win over the Athletics with a home run, one run scored, and two RBI.
impact: After Monday's win, Muncy is slashing .265/.361/.512 with 17 home runs, 37 RBI, 51 runs scored, and one stolen base through 79 games. He's got nine RBI in his last 10 games while batting .270 with a 22% K%.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shohei Ohtani to start Friday
desc: Shohei Ohtani had his next start pushed back to Friday.
impact: Ohtani will pitch Friday's game against the Padres. They will run a bullpen game instead on Wednesday.

author: Chase Davis
title: Andy Pages goes deep, drives in two in 9-4 win
desc: Andy Pages went 2-for-5 in a 9-4 win over the Athletics with a home run, one run scored, two RBI, and two strikeouts.
impact: Through 84 games this season, Pages is batting .269 with 16 home runs, 60 RBI, 51 runs scored, eight stolen bases and a .349 wOBA. The homer snaps a 17-game power skid, during which he batted only .227. Hopefully, this gets him going again.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Willy Adames (back) not in lineup Tuesday
desc: Willy Adames is not in the Giants lineup on Tuesday against the Diamondbacks.
impact: Adames remains day-to-day after he had an MRI reveal no structural damage.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Daniel Palencia (elbow) to be sidelined through All-Star break
desc: Cubs manager Craig Counsell said Daniel Palencia is not expected back until after the All Star break.
impact: Palencia resumed a throwing program on Monday.

author: Chase Davis
title: Eric Lauer grinds through six for win vs. A's
desc: Eric Lauer allowed three earned runs on nine hits and one walk while striking out two over six innings in Monday's win over the Athletics.
impact: After the win, Lauer now has a 4.84 ERA and 1.27 WHIP with a 4-5 record across 11 starts. He allowed four hard hits and picked up nine whiffs on 95 pitches. He's gone at least six innings in three straight appearances, although his last outing was following an opener. He'll look to keep it going next time out against the Padres.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Drew Pomeranz making his way in Triple-A
desc: Cubs manager Craig Counsell said Drew Pomeranz is making his way in Triple-A Iowa.
impact: Pomeranz signed a minor league contract with the Cubs. He could get called up to the majors at some point in July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jameson Taillon (hamstring) could begin rehab assignment this week
desc: Cubs manager Craig Counsell said Jameson Taillon could go on a rehab assignment this week.
impact: Taillon threw a live batting practice session on Tuesday. He'll likely require a handful of starts on a rehab assignment before he is activated.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jazz Chisholm Jr. available off bench Tuesday
desc: Jazz Chisholm Jr. is available off the bench for Tuesday's game against the Tigers.
impact: Chisholm was cleared following his early exit on Tuesday. He could be back in the lineup on Wednesday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Aaron Judge (rib) 'starting to feel better'
desc: Yankees manager Aaron Boone said Aaron Judge has "started to feel better" this week.
impact: It is an encouraging sign for Judge. He still hasn't been cleared to resume baseball activities yet.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jackson Jobe (elbow) progressing in right direction
desc: Jackson Jobe is progressing in the right direction on his way back from Tommy John surgery.
impact: Jobe threw 100 mph in his live session against hitters last Saturday. He'll head on a lengthy rehab assignment soon.
